explanation: On 9 November, a poorly briefed official told a press conference that new travel rules applied immediately. Crowds gathered at the crossings, and guards opened them that night.

claims.text: The Berlin Wall fell in 1989, when its crossings opened on 9 November.
The wall was built in 1961, and it did not fall in 1985 or 1991.
On 9 November 1989 East German official Günter Schabowski told a press conference that new travel rules took effect immediately.
Crowds gathered at the Berlin crossings and guards opened them on the night of 9 November 1989.
